reason: Losing two big customers means I need new business, but it also means I can't drop EUR 1,500 up front on outreach I'm fairly sure I can run myself with Apollo and a couple of evenings. I'd take the free 15 companies and the first message, then try sending them myself.
objection: I've paid for tools and a freelancer before and got noise, not meetings. And if those messages go out under my company's name and annoy people, or a German prospect complains about GDPR, it's my reputation that takes the hit, not yours. A GDPR pack on paper doesn't change that.
would_change_my_mind: A real phone call with the logistics client who got 45 meetings, and nothing paid up front, so I only pay per qualified meeting that actually happens.
